parameters.script:
$ErrorActionPreference = 'Stop'
# --- EDIT THESE TWO LINES ---
$Base    = 'C:\Scripts\RenameDevice'          # folder with the .ps1 files (all 6, incl. IntuneGraphCommon.ps1)
$GroupId = 'REPLACE_WITH_YOUR_GROUP_GUID'     # Entra/Intune group object ID
# ----------------------------
$Work = Join-Path $Base 'work'
New-Item -ItemType Directory -Path $Work -Force | Out-Null

# Graph credentials come from machine environment variables set on this host:
#   RENAMEDEVICE_TENANT_ID / RENAMEDEVICE_CLIENT_ID / RENAMEDEVICE_CLIENT_SECRET
& (Join-Path $Base 'Get-IntuneGroupDevices.ps1') `
    -GroupId $GroupId `
    -OutputPath (Join-Path $Work 'devices.json')
exit $LASTEXITCODE

$ErrorActionPreference = 'Stop'
$Base = 'C:\Scripts\RenameDevice'
$Work = Join-Path $Base 'work'

# Consumes the collector's enriched devices.json -> performs ZERO extra Graph reads.
# Exit 0 = every device clean; exit 1 = some need attention (routes to this node's error output).
& (Join-Path $Base 'Rename-IntuneDevice.ps1') `
    -InputJson (Join-Path $Work 'devices.json') `
    -Rename -Force -PassThruJson `
    -JsonSummaryPath (Join-Path $Work 'rename-result.json')
exit $LASTEXITCODE

$ErrorActionPreference = 'Stop'
$Base = 'C:\Scripts\RenameDevice'
$Work = Join-Path $Base 'work'

# Every device clean -> resolve any open incident opened by a previous failing run (no-op if none).
& (Join-Path $Base 'Close-ServiceNowIncident.ps1') `
    -CorrelationId 'intune-rename-devices' `
    -InputJson (Join-Path $Work 'rename-result.json')
exit $LASTEXITCODE

$ErrorActionPreference = 'Stop'
$Base = 'C:\Scripts\RenameDevice'
$Work = Join-Path $Base 'work'
$summary = Join-Path $Work 'rename-result.json'

# ServiceNow creds from env: SNOW_INSTANCE / SNOW_USER / SNOW_PASSWORD
$a = @{
    ShortDescription = 'Some devices need manual rename or reinstall'
    CorrelationId    = 'intune-rename-devices'   # stable key: dedups here, closed by the same key
    Urgency          = 3
    OutputPath       = (Join-Path $Work 'incident.json')
}
if (Test-Path $summary) { $a.InputJson = $summary; $a.OnlyIfAttention = $true }
else { $a.Description = 'The Intune rename automation failed before producing a summary. Check the run logs.' }

& (Join-Path $Base 'New-ServiceNowIncident.ps1') @a
exit $LASTEXITCODE
